disambiguation: It is meant to sit alongside Breadcrumbs, not replace it.
extras: Requires BRAT plugin for beta installation.
intentEvidence: A link in Obsidian says only that two notes are connected, never how.
problem: Standard Obsidian links only show that two notes are connected, but not the nature of that connection (e.g., parent, employer).

summary: A plugin that allows users to label connections between notes using a registry, displaying the label on the link and its inverse on the connected note.
